Game Overview

In Ghost Tower, the core idea is straightforward: stack spooky, ghost-shaped blocks in Ghost Tower, balancing precision and timing to reach incredible heights. With every perfect drop, you'll scale new records, while missteps will test your patience. Engage in this Halloween-themed tower-building challenge and see how high you can go before everything comes tumbling down!

Ghost Tower keeps its controls loop simple so the focus stays on the challenge. Stack spooky, ghost-shaped blocks in Ghost Tower, balancing precision and timing to reach incredible heights.
